description: Server-side proxy handler for Next.js, managing request/response headers, CSP, and route-specific logic.

methods.name: safeGet
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves configuration values from Vercel Edge Config, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: isAscii
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only ASCII characters.

methods.name: stripNonAscii
methods.description: Removes non-ASCII characters from a string.

methods.name: sanitizeRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sanitizes request headers by removing non-ASCII characters and handling mojibake.

methods.name: isPagePathRequest
methods.description: Determines if a URL path corresponds to a page request, excluding API and Next.js internal paths.

methods.name: shouldEnforceCsp
methods.description: Checks if Content Security Policy should be enforced based on URL path.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Main request handler that manages routing, header enrichment, CSP, and response modifications.

methods.name: responseWithHeaders
methods.description: Adds CSP and embed headers to the response.

methods.name: enrichRequestWithHeaders
methods.description: Enriches the request with CSP headers if applicable.
